# Random Game Idea: Orbit Dodger

**Concept**: Player pilots a small ship that orbits a planet in an HTML canvas. Asteroids and debris drift inwards on curved trajectories. The ship can thrust forward or reverse to adjust its orbit and collect occasional power‑ups.

**Lose Condition**: The game ends when the ship collides with an asteroid/debris or runs out of fuel.

**Core Loop**: Continuous orbiting, dodge incoming obstacles, manage fuel, and aim for a high survival time score.

1: // Simple Orbit Dodger game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the page.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Full‑screen canvas
8:   const resize = () => {
9:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
10:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
11:   };
12:   resize();
13:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
14: 
15:   const center = () => ({ x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 });
16: 
17:   // Ship state
18:   const ship = {
19:     angle: 0,          // radians
20:     radius: 120,        // distance from centre
21:     angularVel: 0,      // rad/s
22:     fuel: 100,
23:     size: 8,
24:   };
25: 
26:   // Obstacles
27:   const obstacles = [];
28:   const maxObstacles = 30;
29:   const spawnInterval = 1500; // ms
30:   let lastSpawn = 0;
31: 
32:   // Game state
33:   let score = 0;
34:   let startTime = null;
35:   let gameOver = false;
36: 
37:   // Input handling (thrust changes angular velocity)
38:   // Audio setup
39:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
40:   const playTone = (freq, duration) => {
41:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
42:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
43:     osc.type = 'sine';
44:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
45:     osc.connect(gain);
46:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
47:     const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
48:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
49:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, now + 0.01);
50:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + duration / 1000);
51:     osc.start(now);
52:     osc.stop(now + duration / 1000);
53:   };
54: 
55:   const playThrust = () => playTone(440, 100);
56:   const playCollision = () => playTone(150, 300);
57: 
58:   const keys = {};
59:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
60:     // Resume audio context on first user interaction
61:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
62:     keys[e.code] = true;
63:   });
64:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
65: 
66:   const update = dt => {
67:     if (gameOver) return;
68:     // fuel consumption
69:     if (ship.fuel > 0) {
70:       if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
71:         ship.angularVel += 0.0008 * dt;
72:         ship.fuel -= 0.02 * dt;
73:         playThrust();
74:       }
75:       if (keys['ArrowDown']) {
76:         ship.angularVel -= 0.0008 * dt;
77:         ship.fuel -= 0.02 * dt;
78:       }
79:     }
80:     // natural drag
81:     ship.angularVel *= 0.9995;
82:     ship.angle += ship.angularVel * dt;
83:     // keep radius constant (orbit), could add radial thrust later
84: 
85:     // Spawn obstacles
86:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval && obstacles.length < maxObstacles) {
87:       const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
88:       obstacles.push({ angle: ang, radius: Math.max(canvas.width, canvas.height), speed: 0.04 + Math.random() * 0.06, size: 6 + Math.random() * 4 });
89:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
90:     }
91:     // Update obstacles (move inward)
92:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
93:       const o = obstacles[i];
94:       o.radius -= o.speed * dt;
95:       if (o.radius < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
96:     }
97:     // Collision detection
98:     const shipPos = polarToCart(ship.radius, ship.angle);
99:     for (const o of obstacles) {
100:       const pos = polarToCart(o.radius, o.angle);
101:       const dx = shipPos.x - pos.x;
102:       const dy = shipPos.y - pos.y;
103:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
104:       if (dist < ship.size + o.size) {
105:         gameOver = true;
106:         playCollision();
107:         break;
108:       }
109:     }
110:     // Update score
111:     score = ((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
112:   };
113: 
114:   const polarToCart = (r, a) => {
115:     const { x, y } = center();
116:     return { x: x + r * Math.cos(a), y: y + r * Math.sin(a) };
117:   };
118: 
119:   // Pre‑generated starfield for background
120:   const stars = Array.from({ length: 150 }, () => ({
121:     x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
122:     y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
123:     r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
124:     opacity: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
125:   }));
126: 
127:   const draw = () => {
128:     // Motion‑blur trail effect
129:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
130:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
131:     // Stars
132:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
133:     for (const s of stars) {
134:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.opacity;
135:       ctx.beginPath();
136:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
137:       ctx.fill();
138:     }
139:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
140:     const { x, y } = center();
141:     // planet with radial gradient
142:     const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 10, x, y, 30);
143:     planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#555');
144:     planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#111');
145:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
146:     ctx.beginPath();
147:     ctx.arc(x, y, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
148:     ctx.fill();
149:     // ship (triangle with glow)
150:     const shipPos = polarToCart(ship.radius, ship.angle);
151:     ctx.save();
152:     ctx.translate(shipPos.x, shipPos.y);
153:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
154:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0f0';
155:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
156:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
157:     ctx.beginPath();
158:     ctx.moveTo(ship.size, 0);
159:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.size, ship.size / 2);
160:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.size, -ship.size / 2);
161:     ctx.closePath();
162:     ctx.fill();
163:     ctx.restore();
164:     // obstacles with slight variation
165:     for (const o of obstacles) {
166:       const pos = polarToCart(o.radius, o.angle);
167:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(pos.x, pos.y, 0, pos.x, pos.y, o.size);
168:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#f88');
169:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#800');
170:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
171:       ctx.beginPath();
172:       ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, o.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
173:       ctx.fill();
174:     }
175:     // HUD
176:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
177:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
178:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}s Fuel: ${Math.max(0, ship.fuel).toFixed(0)}`, 10, 20);
179:     if (gameOver) {
180:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
181:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
182:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
183:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
184:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
185:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
186:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
187:       ctx.fillText(`Survived ${score}s`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 40);
188:     }
189:   };
190: 
191: 
192:   };
193: 
194:   let lastTime = performance.now();
195:   const loop = now => {
196:     const dt = now - lastTime;
197:     lastTime = now;
198:     if (!startTime) startTime = Date.now();
199:     update(dt);
200:     draw();
201:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
202:   };
203:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
204: })();
